blocks.orig: Nimali Tarangire is an intimate camp situated next to a dry riverbed, in between acacia and baobab trees. The accommodation lies quietly in its own concession area away from the big tourist stream. Each of the ten guest tents is large and stylishly furnished, offering a large, leather strapped travelling chest, private deck and en-suite facilities including a double vanity basin and revitalizing rain shower. The spacious decks are perfect for private dining and in-room spa treatments. Enjoy the pool overlooking a waterhole from which wild animals regularly drink.
blocks.html: Set beside a dry riverbed among acacia and baobab trees, Nimali Tarangire is an intimate camp. It lies peacefully in its own concession, away from the main flow of tourists. All ten guest tents are spacious and stylishly decorated, with a large leather strapped travelling chest, a private deck and en-suite facilities that include a double vanity basin and a refreshing rain shower. The generous decks are ideal for private dining and in-room spa treatments. Relax at the pool, which overlooks a waterhole where wild animals come to drink on a regular basis.

blocks.orig:
The only ‘photographical hide’ in Tanzania
In the private concession of Nimali, they have made their own photographical hide next to the waterhole where the animals frequently gather to drink. In this hide, you can get close to the animals and capture the most beautiful pictures. This is a unique opportunity!
blocks.html:
The one and only ‘photographical hide’ in Tanzania
Within its private concession, Nimali has built its own photographical hide beside the waterhole where animals often come together to drink. From this hide you can get near the animals and take wonderful photographs. It is a one-of-a-kind opportunity!
